bridge-type.label: Risco
bridge-type.description: This bridge represents the Risco TCP interface.

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Risco Panel Host name or IP address
parameter.description: The hostname or IP address of the panel

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Risco Panel port
parameter.description: The TCP port of the panel. Default port is 1000

parameter.name: id
parameter.label: Risco Panel ID
parameter.description: The panel ID. Panel's default value is 1

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Risco Panel communication password
parameter.description: The panel's communication password. Panel's default value is 5678

parameter.name: encoding
parameter.label: Risco Panel communication encoding
parameter.description: The encoding used in the communication with the panel. Default value UTF-8

parameter.name: connectionDelay
parameter.label: Connection delay
parameter.description: Older panels require a delay after the initial connect.Usually 10000 msec. Default value is 0
